421892.title: Shrek 5
421892.overview: Shrek and Donkey team up for another whirlwind, big-city adventure, this time in the magical city of Further Further Away.

787844.title: Newborn
787844.overview: After serving seven years in solitary confinement, Chris Newborn seeks to rebuild his life and reconnect with his family only to find that freedom has become a terrifying psychological battleground.

920708.title: Vāranāsi
920708.overview: Follows Rudhra's perilous adventures as ancient Varanasi stands on the brink of catastrophe from a looming asteroid in 2027 CE, unfolding across multiple timelines and distant continents.

1130948.title: Rosebush Pruning
1130948.overview: In a Spanish villa, American siblings Jack, Ed, Anna and Robert wallow in isolation and their inherited fortune. When Jack wants to move in with his girlfriend and Ed uncovers the truth about their mother’s death, the fabric of the family begins to unravel.

1149700.title: The Last Sunday of High School
1149700.overview: The day after graduation, four high school friends reunite for one last hangout—revisiting old memories, ending an era, and looking into the unknown.
1149700.trailerName: The Last Sunday of High School | Official Final Trailer

1149764.title: Sukkwan Island
1149764.overview: In an effort to reconnect with his estranged father, 13-year-old Roy agrees to spend a formative year of adventure on the remote Sukkwan Island deep in the Norwegian fjords. What starts as a chance to rebuild their relationship quickly descends into a test of survival as they face the harsh realities of their environment and confront their unresolved turmoil.

1191876.title: From the Ashes
1191876.overview: Jailed for her husband's crime, a woman discovers that her only way out is to solve riddles from her mysterious past.

1215812.title: Karavali
1215812.overview: Karavali is a film that explores the struggles between man and nature, set against the raw, untamed beauty of coastal Karnataka. The story revolves around the world of Kambala, a traditional annual buffalo race, showcasing the unique culture and challenges of the region.
1215812.trailerName: Karavali Promo | Prajwal Devaraj | Gurudatha Ganiga | Hyphen Pictures

1217924.title: Unstoppable
1217924.overview: Kaya has always wanted to be just like all the other cells in her part of the body. So, when the others begin preparing for the great quest, and she’s left behind - her heart breaks. Determined to find her own way, Kaya sets off, alone, into the vast and mysterious world of the body. Along the way, she rescues the grumpy but noble General Abel and despite being total opposites, an unlikely friendship begins to bloom. When danger grows from within, Kaya and Abel must work together to protect the body they call home, and Kaya must discover that what sets her apart might just be what makes her truly special.

1243460.title: Joe's College Road Trip
1243460.overview: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.

1249668.title: A Table For Two
1249668.overview: Their separate worlds converge when a restaurant owner suggests they "share a table" during overlapping lunch breaks. What starts as awkward silence evolves into tacit understanding over shared noodles, leading them to explore Shanghai's culinary scene together .

1261188.title: The Swedish Connection
1261188.overview: Swedish Foreign Ministry bureaucrat Gösta Engzell, overlooked during WWII, rescued thousands while turning supposedly neutral Sweden into a moral force. His efforts challenged the status quo and left a lasting humanitarian legacy.
1261188.trailerName: The Swedish Connection – Official Trailer | English | Netflix

1290436.title: Summer Beats
1290436.overview: Paris, a working-class neighborhood in the 19th arrondissement. Shaï and Djeneba are 19 years old and have been friends since childhood. One is burdened by an overbearing family. The other by deep loneliness. Over the course of a summer, they work as counselors at a summer camp, far from the tower blocks where they grew up—no longer quite children, yet officially responsible for a group of kids aged 6 to 10. On the cusp of adulthood, they will have to make choices to grow up and reinvent their friendship.

1306500.title: Moon Walk
1306500.overview: Moonwalk is a family comedy entertainer starring Prabhudeva, Yogi Babu, Aju Varghese, and Arjun Ashokan. Featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the film marks the high-profile reunion of Rahman and Prabhudeva after 30 years. Moonwalk also serves as Rahman’s acting debut. Designed as a wholesome theatrical experience, the film combines high-energy dance, music, and humor for families, children and audiences of all ages.

1306820.title: Mad Dance Office
1306820.overview: Kuk-hee, a by-the-book district office civil servant, has lived a flawless, tightly scheduled life. With a promotion imminent and her daughter's future secured, everything is going according to plan. Until it all unravels—her promotion is taken, her daughter disappears, and an unexpected emptiness sets in. Searching for balance again, Kuk-hee ends up in the last place she ever expected: a flamenco dance studio.

1306884.title: Gorky Resort
1306884.overview: The year is 1939. The world is falling into chaos. Thousands of Poles, held by the Russians in a former monastery, are subjected to brutal indoctrination. An ambitious enemy agent makes it a point of honour to break the resistance of one of them. He is a young, world-famous pianist, respected by his fellow prisoners. His capitulation may result in winning many others over to the enemy's side. An insidious game begins, full of sophisticated manipulation, threats and promises. Can the young artist, a loving father and husband, win a duel with an agent backed by the power and perfidy of the Russian system?

1307524.title: Lady Parts
1307524.overview: Traci, a gallerist, is relentlessly pursued by a sadistic killer fixated on a painting that once graced her gallery's centerpiece. Following a home invasion, Traci's friends come to offer solace and protection. But as the bodies begin to pile up, Traci is thrust into a desperate search for the painting, knowing it’s the only chance to stop the killer’s relentless slaughter.

1328580.title: Death Cycle
1328580.overview: After the death of her sister, a woman is visited by a man looking to solve a series of murders by a motorcycle riding maniac. As their shared fear escalates, the killer's rampage continues in the city, leaving them both questioning who the real monster is.
1328580.trailerName: Death Cycle | Official Trailer | Horror Brains

1337732.title: The Table: Day and Night
1337732.overview: Four different couples' love stories are told as they each visit a cafe in a quiet alley. Their romances are in different stages, from sweet to bitter, like the different varieties of coffee available at the cafe.

1339588.title: Finding Emily
1339588.overview: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

1356484.title: Ach, diese Lücke, diese entsetzliche Lücke
1356484.overview: Twenty-year-old Joachim is unexpectedly accepted at drama school in Munich and moves into his grandparents' upper-class villa. From then on, he tries to find his identity as a young man between the world of theater and the everyday life of his eccentric grandparents.

1360708.title: Let's Love
1360708.overview: When a director, actor, screenwriter and actress reunite for the 10th Anniversary of their one-hit wonder film for a convention that suddenly gets cancelled, they must improvise and come up with ideas for a sequel while in rural Wales.

1373956.title: Die Ältern
1373956.overview: A writer in a midlife and marital crisis, overwhelmed by his growing children and unable to accept change, meets another woman. A bit half-hearted and unintentionally funny, he tries to do something different.

1387140.title: Boy
1387140.overview: On the edge of a corrupt city lies the "Texas Hot Spring," run by brothers Ro-han and Gyo-han. Ro-han meets Jae-in, a girl abused by her mother, and ends up selling her drugs, causing her death. Meanwhile, Gyo-han, allied with the local crime boss, decides to sell Jae-in, blaming her for his brother's change in behavior. Ro-han refuses and escapes with her, determined to protect her.

1408324.title: City Wide Fever
1408324.overview: Sam, a young film student, discovers a USB detailing the life and career of forgotten Italian horror director Saturnino Barresi. As she begins to investigate his mysterious disappearance, Sam finds herself pulled into a violent conspiracy eerily similar to those of the films she adores.

1417668.title: Star Wars: Starfighter
1417668.overview: An original story set approximately five years after the events of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

1418308.title: Ghost Board
1418308.overview: A group of friends stumbles upon an ancient board game hidden in a remote temple. Once the die is cast, a vengeful spirit is unleashed, turning the game into a deadly trap. To survive, they must figure out how to end it before they become its next victims.
1418308.trailerName: [OFFICIAL TRAILER 2] Ghost Board: Random Spirit Box

1419076.title: Funky Freaky Freaks
1419076.overview: In a small city where redevelopment has stalled, three high school friends struggle with their own obsessions: Yong-gi, a self-styled "attention seeker" dreaming of becoming a superhero; Ji-sook, a "pro-ana" obsessed with losing her weight; and Dumbo, a "netkama" who scams money online by pretending to be a girl. Their fragile friendship unravels when Woo-joo, a charming transfer student and an influencer, shows up. Ji-sook falls for him instantly, while Yong-gi, who has been secretly in love with her, can only watch. But when Woo-joo's real self is revealed Ji-sook starts to collapse, Yong-gi's hidden feelings turn into a dangerous plan for revenge.

1422084.title: As the Hydra Devours History
1422084.overview: Four Filipinos confront the slow erasure of memory and truth in a country devoured by disinformation.
1422084.trailerName: Habang Nilalamon ng Hydra ang Kasaysayan (2026) Official Trailer - Opens June 3 - Zanjoe Marudo

1450500.title: Paris Paris
1450500.overview: Three men—from China, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and Palestine—live together in a squatted apartment in a seemingly abandoned building in Paris. The group is bound together by their shared experience of life in exile and the fleeting nature of their possessions, relationships, and sense of home, but the temporary safe space is threatened by outside forces and events.

1451588.title: Corporate Retreat
1451588.overview: Blending the dread of survival horror with dark laughs and shocking twists, "Corporate Retreat" centers around a group of young executives whose luxury team-building trip descends into a bloody fight for survival against a vengeful retreat leader.

1473092.title: East Did Meet West
1473092.overview: Inspired by the 1930s court case Roldan vs. Los Angeles County, Filipino Salvador  Roldan and English Marjorie Rogers must find a way to convince an attorney to fight  for their marriage despite the anti-miscegenation laws of the time.

1474628.title: The Weed Eaters
1474628.overview: Four slacker friends on a rural New Year’s getaway stumble across their reclusive host’s deadly stash: a killer strain of weed that makes unsuspecting stoners crave human flesh.
1474628.trailerName: The Weed Eaters | Official Trailer | IN NZ CINEMAS APRIL 30

1477572.title: Visitation
1477572.overview: A plot of land, a house by the lake, its changing inhabitants. This one plot of land reflects 70 years of German history from Weimar, the Nazis, the war, the Soviet occupation and reconstruction to the fall of the GDR.

1486020.title: Upiro
1486020.overview: Spain, 1755. Ana is sent to a cloistered monastery where several nuns are afflicted by a mysterious  disease. With the help of an unorthodox priest, the young novice uncovers an ancient legend and  malevolent force: a bloodthirsty upiro.

1490884.title: My Boyfriend's Wife Is Dead
1490884.overview: After a tough divorce, Lena enters into a throuple with glamorous couple Iris and Dean for some fun. But when Iris is murdered, all eyes are on Lena. She fights to prove her innocence, but is the real killer closer to home than she thinks?

1493700.title: Nuevas Raíces
1493700.overview: After fleeing the war in Ukraine, several families rebuild their lives in a village in Seville. Through different conversations and introducing us to their day-to-day, Nuevas raíces shows their process of adaptation, resilience and rooting in a land that, without seeking it, also begins to be home.

1495044.title: BORN SEXY YESTERDAY: Decoding the Enigma of Beauty
1495044.overview: The phrase "Born Sexy Yesterday" is derived from the 1950 film "Born Yesterday." However beneath this superficial portrayal of some women lies a more complex understanding , revealing deeper narratives that resonate with many.  October 1, 1985. The chilling emptiness in Michele Avila's eyes. Her murder, a savage ballet of teenage fury, ripped through the town, festering wounds exposing the venomous underbelly of a seemingly innocent friendship. Jealousy, a serpent coiled in the heart of adolescence, struck with the force of a viper, revealing the terrifying depths of envy's reach. These weren't just girls; they were predators.  Women are born with many layers, a mix between good and evil. Ironically of all the positive tropes that can validate the existence of women, why is it that "Born Sexy Yesterday" is a trope that resonates with our male counterparts the most?
1495044.trailerName: Born Sexy Yesterday: Decoding The Enigma of Beauty

1497348.title: Alas Roban
1497348.overview: The lives of Sita and her daughter, Gendis, change after a terrifying night. Their journey through Alas Roban is filled with fear and relentless terror. Can they uncover what's happening there?

1523140.title: Man of Tomorrow
1523140.overview: Superman and Lex Luthor find themselves forced to work together—to a certain degree—against a much, much bigger threat when Brainiac sets his sights on Earth.

1528580.title: Hermit
1528580.overview: A hermit’s decaying refuge on the edge of civilisation is shattered by his estranged son’s arrival.

1535620.title: Orange Torches
1535620.overview: A twelve year old boy unexpectedly spends the week with his eccentric, underachieving father.
1535620.trailerName: Orange Torches - Official Trailer (2026) Zachary Krueger, Noah Bush

1537860.title: PEAK END
1537860.overview: "Hey Rin, let’s send a jam sandwich to space." Rin came to Kyoto from Seoul, and Sola came to Kyoto from Okinawa. They met at university and have since pursued filmmaking together. They like having fun and they like filming funny things and laughing together. They want to fly a jam sandwich. They want to shoplift a film camera. They want to trace Sora's family roots in Okinawa. The two sublimate their desires to filmmaking. For the two, film is like a magic wand. They transform it into all kinds of genres and put themselves in it. The two desire to know each other, but never compromise and, instead, accept their uncertain identities just to have the greatest conversation.

1545540.title: Axolodyssey
1545540.overview: An animated adventure about Jojo the Axolotl, taking on the world to find his family, set in a fantastically inspired Mexican lakeside.

1547844.title: Tuhan, Benarkah Kau Mendengarku?
1547844.overview: Sarah's life was destroyed when her husband, Satrio, wanted to remarry, making her choose to divorce and struggle as a single mother, but when Satrio became seriously ill, she was forced to take in Satrio and his new wife, Annisa, in her house, testing her fortitude and sincerity in facing inner conflict, jealousy, while learning to forgive and find strength.
1547844.trailerName: Tuhan, Benarkah Kau Mendengarku? - Final Trailer

1554116.title: Qualcosa di Lilla
1554116.overview: The life of 15-year-old Nicole changes when Luce, who has suffered from bulimia since she was a child, joins her class. Consequently, Nicole also slides into the illness without realizing it. But above all, without anyone else noticing.

1563588.title: The Red Hangar
1563588.overview: Chile, 1973. The military coup will force Jorge Silva, an Air Force captain, to face the unfolding horror. Inside a military base, he must choose between becoming part of the repression or helping those fighting to stay alive.

1568964.title: Human Cocaine
1568964.overview: Arjun, a UK based cab driver who is financially struggling to get his estranged wife and daughter back, finds an opportunity to make GBP 25,000 The job is simple: Deliver a parcel to a given address. Along the way, helps a hitchhiker Liza by giving her a ride. But what he doesn’t know is how he is endangering both their lives.
1568964.trailerName: Human Cocaine Trailer | Sarim Momin | Pushkar Jog | Ishita Raj | Siddhanth Kapoor | Zakir Hussain

1580804.title: Дедмобиль
1580804.overview: Valera, a flawless driver with 30 years behind the wheel, loses his job just as his dog Lincoln needs an expensive lifesaving surgery. Desperate for income, he’s approached by a sleek, AI-powered self-driving taxi. To avoid spooking passengers, the car asks Valera to pretend to be its driver and help it achieve a top user rating — in exchange for all the earnings from their rides. For Valera, it’s his dog’s only chance; for the taxi, it’s a fight for its own survival.

1592452.title: Paranormal Activity 8
1592452.overview: The eighth installment in the franchise. Plot TBA.

1593732.title: Beneath the Night
1593732.overview: A metro driver with colorful hair is unexpectedly chosen as the face of a public transport advertising campaign, blurring the lines between the visible and hidden.

1595780.title: Crisis Actor
1595780.overview: Fired from her day job, an impulsive actress crashes a support group and spirals into a chaotic night that forces her to face her addiction to drama.

1601732.title: Djamin Setia Selamanya
1601732.overview: A young man from Tanah Karo who becomes a central figure in Indonesia’s independence struggle. Born in 1921 and educated under Dutch rule, Djamin joins Gyugun with hopes of freedom, only to realize true sovereignty must be fought for. Alongside Likas Tarigan, he leads brilliant guerrilla tactics in North Sumatra while torn between devotion to family and unwavering duty to his homeland.
1601732.trailerName: Official Trailer Film DJAMIN SETIA SELAMANYA.

1607748.title: Future Science - Das Ende der Tierversuche?
1607748.overview: In the departure from animal testing, visionary researchers are redefining medicine with AI and artificial organs, but their greatest obstacle isn't disease—it's the scientific establishment that created them.

1610820.title: Santo António - O Casamenteiro de Lisboa
1610820.trailerName: Santo António: O Casamenteiro de Lisboa [Teaser]

1611268.title: Der Thüringenkrimi - Gerechtigkeit
1611268.overview: The dead woman is the controversial family court judge Sophie Nöll. Chief Inspector Moritz Herbst therefore doubts that it was an accident. Mala quickly recognizes signs of a crime. Those who were severely affected by Nöll's judgments are now suspects.

1615492.title: Three Colors: Pan-African
1615492.overview: An anthology feature film exploring contemporary Black existence through the Pan-African flag: A collegiate football star scrambles to save his career after a devastating injury fractures his sense of self-worth; a Ghanaian single mother loses her job and faces deportation as an unlikely group of heroes rally around her; the lead of a struggling Black sitcom questions the cost of success as the network forces the show into racist caricature to boost ratings.

1616452.title: Human Theories
1616452.overview: Through forty interconnected vignettes, Human Theories is a comedic kaleidoscope exploring how people try, and often fail, to connect with one another in this weird world. Filmed over a year on location in New York City with a diverse ensemble cast of over 50 actors and non-actors, the film is an experimental love letter to the awkward struggle of modern city living.

1617412.title: Lazarus: The Awakening
1617412.overview: A vigilante resurrected from death hunts a drug empire in Jackson, clashing with a kingpin, a reporter, and a city consumed by fentanyl. Justice becomes war.

1620996.title: The Blue Box
1620996.overview: Pablo is a young, wealthy but solitary man traumatized by a fatal car accident. He meets Lara through a dating app tied to an exchange of the titular blue box. As their relationship grows, Lara draws Pablo out of his shell. But an anonymous warning alerts Pablo that Lara may not be all that she seems. What begins as an intimate connection gradually turns into a tense psychological game of cat and mouse, forcing Pablo to confront both his past and the true nature of the woman he is falling in love with.

1621892.title: Fırtına Kız
1621892.overview: Zeynep inherits the extraordinary talent of her father İsmail, once known as Diyarbakır’s most gifted yet unluckiest footballer. But talent alone is not enough, she must fight for equal opportunity to pursue her dreams. As İsmail struggles to accept his daughter’s ambition, Zeynep is forced into marriage, only to make a daring escape. Haunted by the sacrifice of a sibling who took the blame for her, she pushes forward and ultimately steps onto the field wearing the national team jersey, becoming a symbol of hope and courage for countless girls.

1624964.title: Marta
1624964.overview: Based on the true-life events of six-time FIFA World Player of the Year, Marta Vieira da Silva, widely regarded as the greatest female football player of all time.

1628484.title: Katt Williams: The Last Report
1628484.overview: Back for his fourth Netflix stand-up special, comedy icon Katt Williams delivers his famously bold takes on conspiracies, celebrities and the world at large in this electrifying set.

1633540.title: The Barrel
1633540.overview: A young prankster wakes trapped in a metal barrel in an abandoned workshop. He must find a way out and learn how and why he got there. Estranged from his devout father, he can only rely on him, shackled to a pole nearby, for guidance.

1634820.title: Living Corpse
1634820.overview: Yosuke Shinkai is haunted by a past he cannot recall - and a body that is rapidly decomposing. He is a living corpse, unclear who he is or why he has been brought back to life only to suffer again a slow gruesome death. Based on the 1986 horror manga by Hideshi Hino.
1634820.trailerName: 映画「怪奇！死肉の男」特報

1636996.title: Blueberry Inn
1636996.overview: When an emotionally-stunted butler is inexplicably gifted a broken-down inn from his Lord, he's suddenly tasked with uniting three chaotic employees and a cheeky pig against the heirs' attempts to bankrupt the inn.

1647044.title: Figure 8: The metal is the ruin of our skin
1647044.overview: At the beginning of summer, an aspiring artist isolates himself to finish a painting, but his addictions to pornography and social media gradually distort his sense of time until a confrontation with his own reflection reveals a consciousness shaped by everything he has been avoiding.

1649476.title: The Last Hunter
1649476.overview: The Dawu Mountain Range is shrouded in mist, yet Baru, a 28-year-old Indigenous man, weaves through the lush forest like it’s his own backyard. On an illicit hunt to prove himself worthy of his pregnant girlfriend, the army deserter is pursued by policeman Sam and poacher Sakinu. As Baru ventures deeper into Paiwan ancestral territory, memories of hunting with his late father reconnect him with Indigenous culture and Nature’s spirits. Yet economic realities drive him to violate a historical taboo, leading to a fateful encounter with the mythical Black Bear, revered by his tribe. Set amid the 1990s Indigenous rights movement in Taiwan, The Last Hunter redefines heroism through a poetic journey into Indigenous spirituality.
1649476.trailerName: 2026高雄電影節｜臺灣越界｜熊山記- SINISUSU TUA PUCUMAYAN｜The Last Hunter

1652036.title: DRUID
1652036.overview: 60 AD. Romans tighten their grip on Britannia. Druidism is hunted almost to extinction. after being driven out of their commune, Rhiain- a young druid and her master Gwen are forced to flee and traverse the wilds of Britannia in order to reach the sanctuary of the Druids - Ynys Môn. On their journey they will encounter great challenges and unlikely allies on a quest that will decide not only their survival, but the future of their way of life itself.

1654276.title: Lives at Right Angles
1654276.overview: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together

1660612.title: Wanda Sykes: Legacy
1660612.overview: Wanda Sykes returns to her alma mater with a fearlessly funny takedown of everything from the state of the world to the cultural clash over washcloths.

1665092.title: Swallowed Star The Movie  - Battle on Primal Star
1665092.overview: During his training on the Original Star, Luo Feng faces constant threats from alien races coveting his strength and resources. Remaining calm and strategic, he uses both intelligence and power to counterattack and defend humanity’s honor. Wielding a formidable and beautiful battle blade, Luo Feng carves a path of destruction through his enemies, declaring, “I have a single strike that can sever the universe.”  As tensions escalate, the demon race, mechanical race, and insect race reappear and form a three-race alliance. Their leaders, along with 6,000 universe-level experts, join forces to encircle and eliminate Luo Feng. In the face of overwhelming odds, Luo Feng unleashes his ultimate technique, “I Am the Universe,” annihilating the coalition in one decisive strike.

1665540.title: White Agbada
1665540.overview: Ibironke, a Nigerian-American woman whose life is stagnant, engages in self-destructive behaviors to cope. Her concerned sister calls her one day to propose a family trip to Nigeria for spiritual assistance. Ibironke is totally against this and continues to engage in her bad habits—including a casual relationship with an engaged prospective business partner who has a baby on the way. When their post-sex discussion accelerates into a fight, an ancestor who has dropped Easter eggs throughout her day appears in her mirror, terrifying her. She immediately knows this climactic sighting is a radical call for change.

1665860.title: Murder in the Dark
1665860.overview: A blind waitress at a dining-in-the-dark restaurant becomes the sole witness to a murder, making her the next target of a killer determined to eliminate the only person who could identify him.

1667716.title: Peace Corps
1667716.overview: Drifting directionlessly around her hometown after unexpectedly being dismissed early from a stint in the Peace Corps, a 30-year-old Asian American woman butts heads with her mother, goes on an ill-advised date with a figure from her past, and ruminates on the meaning of her life.

1677956.title: How to Survive a Marriage
1677956.overview: Maryana is a successful divorce lawyer, but her own marriage to Dima is far from ideal. On her birthday, her mother, the eccentric provincial actress Margarita, unexpectedly arrives. In an attempt to stay and bond with her daughter, Margarita claims Dima has an affair.

1680452.title: To dream it first
1680452.overview: Mikkel and Mathilde are complete opposites, and share nothing except math class on Fridays. But when Mathilde dreams, she encounters a whole new side of Mikkel - who turns out to be dreaming the same dream. Can this meeting change everything?

1680516.title: WHO
1680516.overview: In a high-stakes world where time is scarce and every choice matters, diverse characters face a merciless system where one wrong move means death. Amid intense pressure, they confront moral quandaries and seek truth while testing limits.

1688900.title: Cerimônia
1688900.overview: When I first moved in with friends, it became a habit to have people over all the time.

1690372.title: Krishna Aur Chitthi
1690372.overview: What happens when the "God of Cricket" and the Lord of the Universe reside under the same roof? Krishna Aur Chitthi is a soul-stirring family drama that explores the thin line between fandom and faith, proving that when an intention is pure, every prayer, whether addressed to Vaikuntha or Wankhede, reaches the same destination
1690372.trailerName: Krishna Aur Chitthi Official Trailer | Darsheel Safary | Shining Sun Studioss | Vinaay

1692932.title: Strange Spirits
1692932.overview: In a haunted roadside bar run by the mysterious Ghoulian Madman, a series of twisted horror stories unfold, from cursed video games and alien body snatchers to killer clowns and supernatural nightmares, proving every spirit has a story.

1698884.title: Zugzwang!
1698884.overview: In the shadow of war, a disgraced soldier is discharged back to his home town. In the search for his girlfriend, he is drawn into a game he does not want to play.

1699204.title: Allt Snurrar
1699204.overview: The film depicts a discussion about sexual abuse/trauma in the stage were you are recovering from what you been through. The film focus lays with the first hook-up after the main character, Simon, has been sexually used by his ex. His relation to intimacy and closeness has changed a lot, something that once felt more obvious now bears an uncertainty. The film, through visual language and dialogue, shows his attempt to navigate through everything that has happened and everything that is still living within him.

1699588.title: Commissioned Confession
1699588.overview: An artist born in Jerusalem is commissioned by a German institution to create a work of art about another artist – a sculptor celebrated by the Nazis. He approaches the task with a silent film. How does one describe something that is, by the very nature of its commission, steeped in violence?

1699780.title: Le tueur de la mort qui tue sa mère II

1700484.title: Deserto Branco
1700484.overview: Today is Saturday, all my friends are dead: The film follows Digitaria on tour through South America.

1702020.title: In The Name of Me
1702020.overview: inside a strict all girls Catholic dormitory, Kristy struggles with a recurring nightmare and hidden feelings for her best friend,Merry. As the Easter Tableau performance nears, she must face her own denial by playing as “Peter” the disciple who denied Jesus.
1702020.trailerName: Trailer In The Name of Me

1702532.title: The Hadron Collider: In Search of the Peace Particle
1702532.overview: In the aftermath of Hiroshima, a group of scientists vowed never to turn knowledge into weapons again, and from that promise, CERN was born.  Deep underground, researchers from nations in conflict have worked side by side for decades, driven by curiosity and shared wonder. For 70 years, CERN has stood as an act of hope, a place where collaboration transcends borders, even as the world above grows more divided.  Blending poetry, music and rare archival footage of Oppenheimer with remarkable access to the Large Hadron Collider, the film explores how science, politics and culture collide.

1703620.title: The Metropolitan Opera 2026/27: Così fan tutte

1704196.title: BURNED
1704196.overview: A THIEF DID SOMETHING IN HIS PAST BUT IT IS SLOWLY CATCHING UP TO HIM & HE DOESN'T KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT...

1706564.title: Salitre no more
1706564.overview: For around fifteen years, I have been filming a forest of imburana de cambão trees that has been progressively disappearing, located on the border between the states of Bahia and Pernambuco. The visual saturation created through image overlaps and the division of the screen into three parts fosters the emergence of a particular rhythm, in which pulsating texts impose other forms of escape.The gradual disappearance of this forest echoes texts evoking the consequences of climate change, while also inscribing fire and logging as human acts contributing to this impoverishment.The basis of this film was the installation of the same name presented as part of an exhibition at the Frans Krajcberg Space in 2025. The film is denser. The imburanas de cambão burst into flames as the sertão turns into desert.

1708484.title: CASE 0 : TOMORROW
1708484.overview: In an abandoned, timeless government archive, an unprecedented case is opened: the trial of "The Future" on charges of existential fraud against humanity through a perpetual, unfulfilled promise—only for investigators to discover that the accused might have never existed at all.

1709252.title: Epitaph
1709252.overview: Shortly after breaking up, Marcelo and Camila end up locked inside their apartment. The time they spend together after the breakup awakens a series of memories in each of them.

1709892.title: Flow
1709892.overview: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

1711428.title: Letters to Etel
1711428.overview: Fouad Elkoury is a photographer, Etel Adnan was a writer and painter — both Lebanese, and friends. After Etel’s death, Fouad writes letters to her. Then comes the genocide in Gaza. Her Arab Apocalypse and his photographs resonate together in an attempt to confront the tragedy.

1711876.title: Undisputed
1711876.overview: For 2 months, Aiden started his college career striving for greatness in a niche sport rather than being active in his community.

1712068.title: Trevlig midsommarhelg!
1712068.overview: The highlight of the summer in Västerköping! Gunnar and Marianne celebrate traditionally with the children, herring, schnapps and Gunnar's own kubb rules. At Tom and Yvonne's the celebration risks being canceled while Präst-Björn is intoxicated by the summer and Vino Tinto. For Terese, "7 kinds of flowers under the pillow" brings unexpected consequences and opportunities.

1712452.title: Insidious Possession
1712452.overview: A former A-student begins lashing out in school and at home. Her parents reach out to their priest for help. Only to realize that the girl is possessed by the devil. Now the unexperienced priest must fight for the girl’s soul and the souls of the entire town.
1712452.trailerName: INSIDIOUS POSSESSION || Official Trailer || The Asylum Movie Channel

1713412.title: Cat People
1713412.overview: As Athens faces a stray cat crisis, two veterinarians and a network of volunteers give their time and resources to help the city’s overwhelming cat population

1714116.title: Finding Your Laughter
1714116.overview: Comedian Arlieta Hall turns to improv as a tool to caregive for her father Milton, who is losing himself to Alzheimer’s.

1715076.title: The Exhibitor
1715076.overview: As murders begin to surface around hotels and expos, suspicion around Vi begins to close in. With her past resurfacing and her behavior growing harder to read, one question lingers: What is she really hiding?

1715140.title: Rivals: Messi v Ronaldo
1715140.overview: As football entered a new era of global prominence, two players emerged who would redefine not just greatness but the sport itself. This film looks at two individuals who didn’t just dominate their era – they created one. For over a decade, their rivalry transcended clubs, countries and competitions, becoming the defining story of modern football – reshaping how the game was played, consumed and debated across the world.

1715972.title: CMLL Presenta NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026
1715972.overview: NJPW Fantastica Mania Mexico 2026 took place on June 19, 2026 at Arena México in Mexico City, Mexico, and was the 18th edition of the Fantastica Mania series, featuring wrestlers from Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre (CMLL) and New Japan Pro-Wrestling (NJPW).

1716804.title: Holding Out
1716804.overview: A 125-year-old retired superhero with dementia, and her estranged grandson, are forced to reconnect after she is kicked out of her aged care facility for failing to control her powers.

1718788.title: LATE NIGHT WITH NOBODY
1718788.overview: A look at the life and mess of Cooper Calhoun's chase for his dream.
1718788.trailerName: LATE NIGHT WITH NOBODY (2026) - OFFICIAL TEASER #1

1718980.title: Bumtak Sara ti Nuangen
1718980.overview: A young woman determined to find her mother is about to become their town's first OFW, sending the townsfolk into a frenzy of over-the-top reactions.

1719428.title: Autumn Leaves
1719428.overview: On the edge of herself, Ellie retreats into memory, not to escape, but to find a reason to stay. A quiet, unflinching portrait of a young woman fighting to remember who she was before the world got loud.

1721924.title: Desert Ed
1721924.overview: After the passing of his longtime teammate on the reality TV Show Battlebots, robot engineer Edward Robinson moves out to the desert, where he reflects on his career and adapts a new hermetic lifestyle.

1722052.title: Enhanced – Die Dopingspiele: Zwischen Medizin, Moral und Milliarden
1722052.overview: The controversial Enhanced Games challenge the foundations of modern sport by allowing athletes to use performance-enhancing drugs in pursuit of world records and prize money. As investors, athletes, scientists, and anti-doping officials clash over the project's ambitions, questions emerge about human enhancement, medical risks, commercial interests, and the future of elite competition. Between technological progress, ethical boundaries, and billion-dollar business opportunities, the debate raises a fundamental question: if doping becomes the norm, what remains of sport?

1722372.title: conscious
1722372.overview: After a near fatal car accident, a teenage boy is given an experimental medicine which forces him to say the things he's afraid to say.

1723076.title: The Betrayers
1723076.overview: A former Israeli politician and Soviet dissident finds his betrayer at a Crimean resort, sparking a confrontation with past wounds and questions of justice and forgiveness.

1723140.title: Constructs
1723140.overview: This experimental found-footage film uses state and corporate propaganda to explore the relationship between extractive industry infrastructure and audiovisual materials in Canada's colonial project.

1723268.title: One Day: Look At The Sky
1723268.overview: A reflective soul journeys through memories of love, loss, and identity, ultimately embracing humility and the eternal cycle of transformation, reminding us that even fallen stars can rise again.
1723268.trailerName: One Day  Look At The Sky   Trailer

1723396.title: NJPW G1 Climax 36 - Day 5
1723396.overview: The fifth night of G1 Climax 36 took place on July 22, 2026, at Aore Nagaoka in Nagaoka, Niigata, Japan, and was headlined by a B Block match between Zack Sabre Jr. and Callum Newman.

1723460.title: A Toxic Love Story
1723460.overview: A string of threatening emails escalates into a revenge plot involving a newly married US marshal and his ex-girlfriend.

1724036.title: Prophetess
1724036.overview: An anonymous friend of filmmaker Océane Buxton notices her striking resemblance to Modeste Niquette, a missing woman he once knew. Modeste claimed recurring encounters with extraterrestrials, documenting them through photography before her unexplained disappearance gave her an almost mythical status. Together, Océane and her anonymous friend reconstruct a portrait of this ghostly figure through a docufiction collage of memories, images, and small-town gossip.

1724356.title: In Tania's Head
1724356.overview: Tania Head became a household name as a 9/11 survivor, celebrated for her miraculous escape from the very floor the plane hit. Her story of resilience, coupled with the heartbreaking death of her fiancé, Dave, moved the nation. As president of the Survivors' Network, she was a symbol of American strength, a fixture alongside political elites at Ground Zero. The illusion shattered in 2007 when a New York Times investigation proved her story was a lie: her career, her fiancé, even her identity.

1724868.title: My Father's Kora
1724868.overview: Souleymane, an Afro-German trans man, travels from Berlin to Dakar to repair his father’s kora, and in doing so, himself. A fragile search for harmony between body, sewing, ocean, heritage, and faith.

1726020.title: Carmezin
1726020.overview: Detective Vivian Carmezin is hired to investigate a case, but ends up getting too involved in it.

1726916.title: Bhagdaud
1726916.overview: The relentless rat race of life, exploring the struggles and ambitions of individuals navigating the complexities of their modern existence.
1726916.trailerName: BHAGDAUD || Movie Official Trailer 2026 || Anisha Shrestha, Ghanashyam Joshi, Sarada Rai (Sara)

1729348.title: Uprising
1729348.overview: Through an AI-driven reinterpretation of Mexican Revolution footage captured by the country's cinema pioneers, this documentary offers a fresh look at a pivotal historical moment. It traces the movement's rise, peak, and fall, the birth of a new nation, and invites us to question the narratives that have shaped our identity and the present we inhabit.

1729732.title: Growth of the Soil
1729732.overview: It is late autumn. Isak fights to survive in the wilderness. One day, Inger appears over the mountain. Out of a meeting in need, love grows. In merciless nature, Isak and Inger fight to create a life together. With love as their driving force, they build the farm Sellanraa from nothing. When a dark secret comes to the surface, love is put to the test.

1731012.title: The Woman from the Sea

1732228.overview: Jace and Eli do their long awaited "All-Nighter", while Eli keeps a secret buried waiting to be cracked open

1732292.title: Her Silence
1732292.overview: An international student hosts her visiting parents in her Sydney flat, and spends two fraught days wrestling with her mother’s unspoken apprehensions about the life her daughter has chosen to build in Australia.

1732420.title: Power Trip
1732420.overview: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

1733764.title: God Hunter
1733764.overview: In a world where beings from myth and folklore have entered our realm, an undercover cop infiltrates a trafficking ring that smuggles and sells these beings to find his son.

1734020.title: Quetzadilla!
1734020.overview: Giant monster madness featuring special effects by a real ten year old boy.

1734276.title: Our Town
1734276.overview: Grover's Corners is a quiet little town, full of ordinary folk, living everyday lives. They work, they laugh, they sing, they fall in love and raise their children and grow old. But within those moments of ordinary, everyday life, there are truths that reach out to us all. And a passionate demand to cherish every moment, right now, while we still can. (A joint Welsh National Theatre and Rose Theatre production, filmed at the Rose Theatre in Kingston, London on 19 March 2026.)
1734276.trailerName: Streaming this season | National Theatre at Home

1734340.title: The Art of Quitting Gracefully
1734340.overview: When 41-year-old NYC teacher Joan Cantrell quits her job to finally write the novel she's been avoiding, she's haunted by more than her deadline: her mother also tried to become a writer, and killed herself when she failed.

1734404.title: Instructor
1734404.overview: Martynas, a cocky but kind-hearted Vilnius native, loses his driver’s license due to his foolishness and arrogance. Shrugging it off, Martynas once again upsets his pregnant fiancée, who leaves him and goes to stay with her parents. In an attempt to win her back, he embarks on a seemingly ordinary journey to get his license back, during which he meets an instructor at a strange driving school—and an even stranger teacher.

1734724.title: Preta - Eu Não Ando Só
1734724.overview: An intimate portrait of Preta Gil, crafted from never-before-seen footage and moving testimonials that reveal her strength in the face of life and illness.

1735812.title: A Quiet Man
1735812.overview: A man journey's across an apocalyptic world to visit his wife's grave.

1736324.title: The Fortunate Isles
1736324.overview: In the arid Canary Islands of the 15th century, Fátima is enslaved by a decadent marquis who controls the island’s only source of fresh water. When rebellion erupts and the well runs dry, she ventures into the barren landscape in search of water — and a chance of survival for the entire community.

1736516.title: Queer Edward II
1736516.overview: Spring 1991: As queer life is under attack in Britain, experimental artist Derek Jarman is turning Edward II into a radical protest film. Told through unseen behind-the-scenes footage, this is a story of the power and cost of queer visibility — then and now.

1738180.title: RevPro: Womens's Grand Prix
1738180.overview: RevPro presents the womens grand prix in Wolverhampton

1738244.title: Black Market
1738244.overview: When a rival kidnaps Adesua’s daughter and threatens to burn everything down, the crew faces their most dangerous job yet, one wrong move and they lose more than the money. They lose each other.

1739332.title: Dragon
1739332.overview: In a stagnant mountain pool, A-Mao fishes for a hidden giant lizard, dragging others into a bloody, infectious madness. Paralyzed and numb, his broken husk crawls back to the murk. At his physical limit, can this eerie desire drive his will to transcend the flesh?

1739652.title: Tib Tub, We Need You!
1739652.overview: Three kids and their best friend Tib Tub, a 30-foot-tall robot boy, have one day left to complete the Perfect Summer Checklist. All they have left to do is go for a swim…without accidentally destroying the whole town!

1740868.title: The Little Girl Who Didn't Exist
1740868.overview: When Mel tries to meet the parents of her daughter's new playmate Sara, she finds that everyone claims the child doesn't exist. But as evidence mounts that Sara is real, Mel becomes convinced that someone is hiding the girl to conceal a dark secret.

1741700.title: The Curtain Call
1741700.overview: After becoming involved in the murder of a paparazzo, rising actor Harrison Monroe and kingpin talk show host Jackson Harper clash in the underbelly of Hollywood. In pursuit of fame, Harrison must navigate truth, betrayal, and manipulation—all while appearing as a guest on Jackson’s late night talk show.
1741700.trailerName: The Curtain Call (2026) | Short Film - Trailer

1742468.title: The Great ADHD Myth?
1742468.overview: Psychiatrist Dr Max Pemberton explores the controversy surrounding attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and how it is treated.

1744388.title: Moongirl
1744388.overview: Blurring fiction and reality, Victor Boccard maps an artist’s obsession across decades of paintings revisiting one subject: the woman he buried long ago at the foot of a statue, in this ethereal meditation on grief, memory, and bonds that transcend time.

1746116.title: Captive
1746116.overview: After a group of friends is abducted, they find themselves as the unwilling participants of a violent live stream: one that's impossible to trace and impossible to stop. CAPTIVE is based on real internet crimes and uses multi POV to put the viewer inside their harrowing journey, bringing them face to face with evil.

1746692.title: The Daughter She Left Behind
1746692.overview: After years spent working internationally, Rachel returns home desperate to reconnect with the daughter she left behind. But when a terrifying man threatens Samantha's life, Rachel must finally become the mother she never was.

1747396.title: De Marker presenteert: Missie Flotilla
1747396.overview: The Global Sumud Flotilla sailed towards Gaza, and we provided independent coverage. Gijs Sanders, along with cameraman Diederick Groenewoud, was the first Dutch journalist to board. Until the Israeli army intercepted the fleet.  More than 1,000 activists headed for Gaza on 75 boats. The goal: to break the Israeli naval blockade to deliver aid to the permanent population in Gaza. Previous attempts were intercepted, the passengers arrested, detained in Israel, and deported. Like in October 2025, when the Israeli army intercepted about 40 boats from the Global Sumud Flotilla and arrested more than 450 participants, including climate activist Greta Thunberg.  In April 2026, another aid fleet departed for Gaza. It became the largest Flotilla mission ever. A number of participants went along for a second time. We ask them: why would you go?

1747460.title: RARE
1747460.overview: A man’s dream first date is put at risk when intense headaches threaten to disrupt the moment.

1748228.title: Amerikan Boy
1748228.overview: A short film that explores identity, masculinity, and the search for belonging. At its heart, it’s about the tension between who we are and who we are asked to be. A story told through the lens of Ik a young Nigerian immigrant.

1749316.title: White Shirt
1749316.overview: The son of businessman Vahram Stepanyan, Mark, runs over a man while intoxicated, an incident that becomes life-changing for all the film’s characters. To help his son avoid punishment, Vahram has Mark admitted to a psychiatric hospital, where he meets Sally, a young woman who has been living there for a long time, and falls in love with her.  Determined to get Sally out of the hospital, Mark orchestrates their escape. The two set out to find Sally’s mother, but the journey proves difficult and is filled with challenging trials.

1750020.title: UWAK
1750020.overview: A homeless man who survives by pretending to be disabled discovers a mysterious piece of paper that leads him into an unsettling encounter.

1751428.title: Heard
1751428.overview: A group of girls are dancing in a field, when suddenly one of them is harmed after seeking shelter from a storm. Struggling to keep up with the herd after the incident, she must choose whether to stay or to face the unknown.

1752516.title: The Cat Is A Wide-Eyed Night
1752516.overview: Two brothers' sporadic visits to their death-ridden mother becomes the long-lost road to their unending love for each other.

1752772.title: TNA Lockdown 2026
1752772.overview: The 2026 Lockdown is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA). It will take place on Sunday, August 23, 2026, at Credit Union 1 Arena in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It will be the 13th event under the Lockdown chronology. This event will be the first Lockdown since 2016 and the first to be held as a pay-per-view event since 2014. The event's central theme is that the entire card is contested inside a steel cage. Beyond standard cage matches, the event frequently features specialized variations, most notably the signature Lethal Lockdown match.

1753348.title: Imperfection
1753348.overview: A product of listening, rather than acting. Fireworks and the aquarium.

1753476.title: Wayward 2nema
1753476.overview: Dax, Arthur and Alice continue to deal with the repercussions from the Camera's influence. While something sinister brews in the background

1755204.title: Middling
1755204.overview: Two class (and soul) mates unravel across time, space, and mediocre diner french fries.

1756740.title: Rowan & Olivia
1756740.overview: When Rowan Saoirse, a queer, academically-struggling high school senior, is forced to undergo mandatory tutoring to graduate, she finds herself connected to Olivia Bond, her overachieving catholic classmate. As their relationship begins to blossom, Olivia struggles with accepting her discovered sexuality, split within a battle against Rowan and her own religion.

1759428.title: Nohum
1759428.overview: Three outspoken atheists Daksh, Abhay and Reeti accept an invitation to attend an unusual gathering at a remote farmhouse. What begins as an evening of conversation and intellectual provocation gradually turns into something far more unsettling.  As their hosts introduce ideas that challenge everything the three believe about faith, consciousness and reality, the boundaries between philosophy and experience begin to collapse. Each guest is forced to confront something deeply personal and increasingly impossible to explain.  By the end of the night, their certainty about the world, and their place within it, may no longer survive.

1759684.title: Nhang
1759684.overview: A young mother attempts to carry on the Vietnamese tradition of đám giỗ with her young son. As she lights the incense, the ritual transports her back to memories of childhood and the grandmother who taught her how to carry tradition forward. But the memories reveal something she had forgotten. Now, she must decipher what it means to honor the past while making room for something of her own.

1760836.title: The traveller diaries
1760836.overview: Set in 1978, the film follows Manuel, an employee who becomes entangled in corruption to keep his business and family afloat. As the excesses of this life take their toll, a devastating earthquake forces him to confront his choices before it is too late.
1760836.trailerName: DIARIOS DE UN VIAJERO - Teaser Trailer

1763332.title: Orang Perang
1763332.overview: The struggles of the Senoi Praaq team, a secret unit under the Royal Malaysian Police (PDRM) made up of the Orang Asli community, specifically the Semai and Temiar tribes.
